$comment: Keys are "day-month". lunar/solar: holidays (days off and the main traditional days; red on the sheet). Lunar holiday keys ignore the leap flag. solarSince: a solar holiday counts only from that year (24/11 by Nghị quyết 28/2026/QH16; 27/7 by the Bộ luật Lao động amendment of 21/11/2026, in force 1/3/2027). observances: commemorative and lesser traditional days; festivals: temple festivals (main day). Neither is red, both skip leap months. Sources and checks: see the commit that added them.
